Consolidated Payment

(Establishment and

Expenditure)
column7:
Reduction in
provision by re-
appropriation of
₹900.00 lakh was
attributed to
anticipated saving.
Final excess of
₹606.59 lakh is
overstated by
₹1,259.65 lakh due to
clearance of OB
suspense related to
previous years.
Therefore, it is actual
saving of ₹653.06
lakh. Reasons for
actual saving have not
been intimated (July
2024).
